topic: Data structure improvements and data retention
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on accessing raw device signal data, specifically the `raw_devices_seen_2` table. It was noted that this raw data moves to cold storage after approximately seven days.

[me] suggested migrating the raw seen data into a more structured and performant flat table format, keeping only a few days of raw data on hot storage for efficiency.

Separately, [me] proposed deleting `device_id` records from the `device_session` table older than one full month, while providing a mechanism to restore sessions from the raw seen data upon request. This proposal was accepted by [p1].
decisions: The plan to delete device IDs older than one month from device_session is approved.
A new flat structure for raw seen data is suggested for better performance.
action_items: Implement deletion of old device IDs from the device_session table.
Deploy a new feature/rich listing for New Zealand on production environment.
